# Tổng quan Project

**VoiceScribe / Scribble** — ứng dụng desktop ghi biên bản họp (meeting minutes):
ghi âm realtime → STT (Nvidia Riva / Soniox / offline local) → phân biệt loa (speaker diarization)
→ dịch → tóm tắt bằng LLM → xuất minutes (markdown/DOCX). Chạy hoàn toàn local,
không có multi-tenant, không auth (CORS allowlist cho Tauri webview).

## Tech Stack

| Thành phần    | Phát hiện | Phiên bản       | Driver / Ghi chú                          |
| ------------- | --------- | --------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| Python        | ✓         | 3.11            | sidecar `src-python/`                     |
| FastAPI       | ✓         | >= 0.110.0      | + `uvicorn[standard] >= 0.29.0`           |
| SQLite        | ✓         | stdlib `sqlite3` | WAL mode, thread-local connections       |
| React         | ✓         | 19.1.0          | + `react-dom`, Vite 7, TailwindCSS 4      |
| Tauri         | ✓         | 2.x             | Rust backend (`src-tauri/`), plugins: opener/shell/updater/process/dialog |
| Rust          | ✓         | edition 2021    | tokio, reqwest, hound, ringbuf, cidre (macOS) |
| TypeScript    | ✓         | ~5.8.3          | `zustand`, `@tanstack/react-query`        |
| MongoDB       | ✗         | -               | Không phát hiện trong project này.        |
| Redis         | ✗         | -               | Không phát hiện trong project này.        |
| Elasticsearch | ✗         | -               | Không phát hiện trong project này.        |
| Kafka         | ✗         | -               | Không phát hiện trong project này. Async dùng WebSocket/SSE/threads. |
| PostgreSQL    | ✗         | -               | Không phát hiện trong project này.        |

External STT/LLM SDKs: `nvidia-riva-client >= 2.15.0`, `soniox >= 2.0.0`,
`groq >= 0.5.0`, `openai >= 1.14.0`, `sherpa-onnx >= 1.13.0`,
`mlx-audio` (git pin, macOS arm64 only), `imageio-ffmpeg`.

## Điểm khởi chạy (Entry Points)

| Loại             | File                  | Mô tả                                                        |
| ---------------- | --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| HTTP server      | `src-python/main.py`  | FastAPI app `VoiceScribe Sidecar`, `uvicorn.run(...127.0.0.1:8765)` |
| Desktop shell    | `src-tauri/src/main.rs` + `lib.rs` | Tauri bootstrap, sidecar spawn, audio capture commands |
| Frontend         | `src/main.tsx` → `App.tsx` | React entry, TailwindCSS, i18n (`src/i18n.ts`)          |
| Upload streaming | `src-tauri/src/upload.rs` | Stream file Rust → sidecar `POST /meetings/upload-audio` |

## Danh sách Module

| Module   | Đường dẫn        | Số file | Domain                                              |
| -------- | ---------------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| api      | `src-python/api/` | 7      | 7 REST routers (meetings, transcription, upload, settings, drafts, diagnose, attachments) |
| core     | `src-python/*.py` (root) | 9 | App wiring, SQLite (`db.py`), STT engines, diarizer, translate, summarize |
| services | `src-python/services/` | 7 | Upload pipeline, job registry, audio/VAD, batch diarizer, minutes |
| local    | `src-python/local/` | 3 (+ `__init__`) | On-device STT: device detect, model registry, model download |
| frontend | `src/`           | ~45     | React UI: recording, transcript, summary, settings, upload |
| tauri    | `src-tauri/src/` | 3       | Rust commands: audio capture, upload streaming, file save |

Commit SHA (lúc scan): `1516f0a`. Test suite: `src-python/tests/` (10 files, pytest).

## Cấu trúc thư mục (depth 3, đã loại trừ `__pycache__`, `dist/`, `build/`, `node_modules`)

```
meeting-minutes/
├── src/                    # React + TS frontend (Vite)
│   ├── components/         # MeetingList/Detail, RecordingBar/Panel, TranscriptView, ...
│   │   └── recording/      # hooks: use-streaming-stt, use-chunk-recording, use-summarize, ...
│   ├── lib/                # api.ts, sidecar.ts, sse.ts, upload-audio.ts, ...
│   ├── stores/             # appStore.ts (zustand), updaterStore.ts
│   └── types/              # stt.ts, global.d.ts
├── src-python/             # FastAPI sidecar

│   ├── services/           # pipeline, job_registry, audio, vad_splitter, ...
│   ├── local/              # device_detect, model_registry, model_download
│   ├── models/local/       # bundled sherpa-onnx vi model
│   ├── tests/              # pytest suite
│   ├── main.py / db.py / stt.py / diarize.py / local_stt.py / translate.py / summarize.py
│   └── scribble-sidecar.spec  # PyInstaller bundle config
├── src-tauri/src/          # lib.rs, main.rs, upload.rs
├── docs/                   # auto-update.md, decisions/, reports/, upload-feature/
└── docs/context/           # (thư mục này — generated)
```

## Commands (phát hiện)

| Lệnh | Nguồn | Mục đích |
| ---- | ----- | -------- |
| `pnpm run dev` / `build` / `preview` / `tauri` | `package.json` | Frontend dev / build / Tauri |
| `uvicorn` via `main.py __main__` (`SIDECAR_PORT`, default 8765) | `src-python/main.py:1015` | Chạy sidecar standalone |
| `pytest` (`testpaths = tests`, `pythonpath = .`) | `src-python/pytest.ini` | Test sidecar |
| `src-python/build.sh` + `scribble-sidecar.spec` | PyInstaller | Bundle sidecar binary |
| `build.sh` / `build-windows.bat` (repo root) | shell | Build app |
